requiredResponses.title: Required responses
requiredResponses.description: Kinds of data (as in patterns.js, e.g. aws_access_key) and how Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. Overrides people's own choice.

watchWords.title: Watch words
watchWords.description: Words or phrases (up to 4 words each, 200 at most) to warn about, e.g. project code names. Turned into one-way fingerprints on each computer.

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: People can see but not change Clotr's settings or vault.
